items.text: Single mise-config.toml is source of truth; Ansible must not duplicate, generate, or split the tool list.
Canonical registry names for CLIs; npm:/gem: for executables; pipx: for Python CLIs; pynvim via Python postinstall.
Residual formulae go in [bootstrap.packages] with brew: keys; casks stay in Brewfile, no brew-cask: entries.
Homebrew CLI installed/invoked only for the macOS cask flow; Linux formula provisioning must not need Homebrew.
Move formula to [tools] only after mise install and version smoke check pass on macOS and Linux.
Greenfield bootstrap: standalone mise before Homebrew, config linked globally, Ansible via mise, playbook through mise exec.
Check mise supports `mise bootstrap packages` first; otherwise update via verified standalone install path.
Explicit phases in bootstrap and Ansible: `mise bootstrap packages apply --yes` then `mise install --yes`.
Optional formulae go to mise optional-config example [bootstrap.packages]; optional Brewfile keeps only casks.
Cleanup removes only formulae moved to [tools], after all phases and smoke checks succeed, and only if Homebrew already exists.
Never run `mise bootstrap packages prune --manager brew`; report blocked removals as warnings and skip cleanup if phases fail.
Put /opt/homebrew/bin (macOS) and /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin (Linux) on PATH directly, without brew shellenv.
Delete three legacy default-package files and their symlink/goss checks; doctor.sh points to mise install or packages apply.
Keep floating channels: Node lts, Ruby 3, other CLIs and language packages latest; no exact-version locks.
Support Apple Silicon macOS only, with no Intel formula path; CI must assert the macOS runner is arm64.
`just upgrade` sends formula and tool upgrades through mise and leaves only cask upgrades to Homebrew.
